summary: Frontend-only regression test of the ROUJAUNE Live Workout (/workout) dense-tablet layout on a small-wide viewport (1180x760) and dense 2x2 fallback (980x760). All requested layout fixes verified: TERRAIN card no longer overlaps the POWER tile, metric labels render full text (HEART RATE / SPEED / CADENCE / POWER), everything fits within a 760px-tall viewport without scrolling, and functional controls (DEMO toggle, Pause, Sensors, Settings) work.

critical_code_review_comments: workout.tsx is >1200 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting derivation logic (terrain/kcal/PR/BLE toast/coach cue) into hooks to reduce file size.

Layout math for the dense metric row relies on `leftCenter { flex:1, minWidth:0 }` + `centerCol { flex:1, minWidth:0 }`; this correctly stopped the metric row from overflowing into the right column at 1180w. Good fix.

rca_of_issue: Original bug: at ~small-wide viewports (e.g. Z Fold), the right-column TERRAIN card overlapped the POWER metric tile because the leftCenter/centerCol flex containers had no `minWidth:0`, so the 4-metric row's intrinsic width pushed the right column off-screen and it visually overlapped Power. Fix (verified) added `minWidth:0` on leftCenter + centerCol, narrowed rightW to 196, and added a MetricCard `dense` prop that shrinks the tile paddings/font sizes and hides the connection device-name text (green dot + battery kept) while allowing up to 2 lines for the label so labels stay readable. At 1180x760 all 4 metric tiles + brand + terrain fit on one row with an 8px gap between POWER and TERRAIN; whole screen fits in 760px with no scrolling. At 980x760 the layout correctly collapses to a 2×2 metric grid with terrain still cleanly on the right.
